title: Weather and Silence
author: Dominic Brightwater
blurb: Mara Dunmore, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
